remarks: Newly Renovated 3-Level Townhouse in Prime Downtown Stamford Location! Move right into this beautifully updated townhouse offering the perfect blend of modern style, everyday comfort, and unbeatable convenience. Freshly painted and featuring gleaming hardwood floors throughout, this turnkey home is ready for you! The main level boasts an expansive open-concept living and dining area-ideal for entertaining or relaxing with family. The updated kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and sleek finishes, making meal prep a joy. Upstairs, discover two spacious bedrooms and two fully renovated full bathrooms, designed with comfort and elegance in mind. The lower level offers a versatile room-perfect for a home office, gym, or guest suite-complete with sliding doors leading to a private patio and large communal green space. A dedicated laundry area and attached garage add even more convenience. Enjoy summer days at the in-ground community pool, and take advantage of the unbeatable location-walking distance to Scalzi Park, Downtown Stamford's vibrant shops and restaurants, and just 1.5 miles from Stamford Train Station. Don't miss your chance to own this move-in ready home in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods! INCLUDED IN THE COMMON CHARGES IS HIGH SPEED FIBEROPTIC INTERNET!
